title: GENERATION RAINBOW: A Biography-Based Online Programme for Queer People Aged Over 60
summary: The project “GENERATION RAINBOW” is piloting an online program for queer people aged 60 and older. In small groups, participants will reflect on their personal life stories in the context of queer history (e.g., the AIDS crisis, marriage equality) and connect with others. The aim is to reach older queer individuals—especially those living in rural areas—promote social inclusion, and explore potential positive effects on well-being, loneliness, and quality of life. The sessions will be led by trained young queer volunteers to also encourage intergenerational exchange within the LGBTQ+ community. The study will assess the program’s feasibility and measure its impact using questionnaires completed before and after participation.
conditions: The participants are healthy individuals with age-related limitations. In addition, older queer people represent a particularly vulnerable group in terms of mental and physical health conditions, highlighting the need for a prevention-oriented approach.

interventions.name:
All participants are in the same intervention arm.
Participants in this study arm are queer individuals aged 60 years and older who take part in a biography-oriented online group intervention.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Participants
- Individuals who do not describe their sexual orientation or way of life as heterosexual (non-heterosexual), or who do not or do not fully identify with the gender assigned to them at birth (non-cisgender)
- Age: 60 years or older
- Place of residence: North Rhine-Westphalia (Germany)
- Sufficient German language skills to understand and complete the questionnaires and to participate in the program, which will be conducted in German
- Access to an internet-enabled device, specifically a computer, laptop, or tablet (participation via smartphone is not possible)
- Basic technical skills to operate the device and join a Zoom call

Volunteers
- Individuals who do not describe their sexual orientation as heterosexual (non-heterosexual), or who do not or do not fully identify with the gender assigned to them at birth (non-cisgender)
- Age: Between 20 and 35 years
- Place of residence: North Rhine-Westphalia (Germany)
- Sufficient German language skills to facilitate and guide the group sessions effectively
Exclusion criteria:
- Individuals who describe their sexual orientation or way of life as heterosexual AND fully identify with the gender assigned to them at birth
- Individuals who do not fall within the specified age groups or who do not reside in North Rhine-Westphalia
